page_title: BHA 0-0 IPS | Brighton v Ipswich 14/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+4' Bart Verbruggen (Brighton) says something out of turn to the referee and is shown a yellow card.
90+4' Carlos Baleba (Brighton) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
90+4' Jack Clarke (Ipswich) commits a rough foul. Samuel Barrott stops the game and makes a call.
90+3' Julio Enciso (Brighton) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
90+2' Julio Enciso (Brighton) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.
90+2' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton). Brighton earn a corner.
90' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Leif Davis (Ipswich) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.

89' Ooh that was close! Evan Ferguson (Brighton) collects a pass and runs with pace goalwards before unleashing a great drive from the edge of the box, but it goes inches wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ipswich.
88' The ball possession is 70:30.
85' Joel Veltman (Brighton) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
85' Fabian Hurzeler decides to make a substitution. Danny Welbeck will be replaced by Evan Ferguson (Brighton).
85' Kieran McKenna has decided to substitute Omari Hutchinson and he is replaced by Conor Chaplin (Ipswich).
85' Substitution. Massimo Luongo (Ipswich) in, Samy Morsy out.

83' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) receives a slide-rule pass inside the box and has just the keeper to beat. His shot low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and Arijanet Muric easily makes the save.
81' The defensive wall does its job and blocks the mid-range attempt from the free-kick by Lewis Dunk (Brighton).
80' Poor challenge! Samy Morsy (Ipswich) is penalised for tripping and Samuel Barrott blows his whistle. Brighton are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
79' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) meets a cross inside the box, but Arijanet Muric wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
77' The resulting corner from Kalvin Phillips (Ipswich) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
76' George Hirst (Ipswich) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Ipswich will take a corner kick.

73' Great solo effort by Omari Hutchinson (Ipswich) as he tricks his way through the defence before firing a low drive from just outside of the box towards the middle of the goal. Bart Verbruggen is alert and denies him.
72' Julio Enciso (Brighton) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play.

71' Julio Enciso (Brighton) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The ball goes behind for a corner. Brighton will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

70' Jack Clarke (Ipswich) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brighton.

70' Julio Enciso (Brighton) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike to the bottom left corner. Arijanet Muric pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill.
68' The referee signals a substitution. Simon Adingra (Brighton) is brought on as a substitute for Yankuba Minteh.
68' Fabian Hurzeler prepares a substitution. Jack Hinshelwood is replaced by Ferdi Kadioglu (Brighton).
67' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Julio Enciso (Brighton) comes onto the pitch so that Georginio Rutter can be given a rest.
67' Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
66' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. It will be a corner kick for Brighton.
66' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Yankuba Minteh (Brighton), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
65' Leif Davis (Ipswich) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Bart Verbruggen has no trouble gathering it.
65' Omari Hutchinson (Ipswich) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The linesman points to the corner flag, Ipswich are going to take it.
64' Chiedozie Ogbene (Ipswich) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
63' A pass by Lewis Dunk (Brighton) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
60' Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
59' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jack Clarke (Ipswich) will replace Sammie Szmodics.
59' Here is a change. Liam Delap is going off and Kieran McKenna gives the last tactical orders to George Hirst (Ipswich).
59' A substitution has been made. Wes Burns goes off and Chiedozie Ogbene (Ipswich) comes on.
58' The free kick is delivered by Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
57' Omari Hutchinson (Ipswich) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
57' Yasin Ayari (Brighton) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
55' Liam Delap (Ipswich) creates a good chance for himself and fires in a powerful close-range shot, but his effort ricochets off the left post.
55' Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
54' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. Corner kick. Brighton will have an opportunity.

54' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Georginio Rutter (Brighton), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ipswich.
53' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) fires the ball in from a mid-range free kick, but the effort goes just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ipswich.
51' What was Kalvin Phillips (Ipswich) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
50' Samuel Barrott has a clear sight and sees a foul from Omari Hutchinson (Ipswich).
49' Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
49' Bart Verbruggen (Brighton) is punished with the yellow card.
49' Georginio Rutter (Brighton) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Brighton.
47' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.

47' Carlos Baleba (Brighton) creates a yard of space for himself and tries an effort from the edge of the box, but it goes just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ipswich.
46' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Samuel Barrott blows his whistle for a foul after Georginio Rutter (Brighton) hacks down one of his opponents.
45+1' Yasin Ayari (Brighton) sends a cross into the box, but Arijanet Muric comes off his line to gather the ball.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
44' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
43' Kalvin Phillips (Ipswich) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
43' Carlos Baleba (Brighton) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
41' Samuel Barrott couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Jacob Greaves (Ipswich) and blew his whistle.
39' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) forces a pass into the box, but Arijanet Muric is alert and does a great job to rob him of the ball.

37' Yasin Ayari (Brighton) has a shot blocked, it rebounds back to him, but even on his second attempt he cannot hit the target. His effort goes well wide. The ball goes out of play and Ipswich will have a goal kick.
37' The corner from Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton) is hurriedly cleared.

36' A pass into the box finds Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the bottom left corner, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Arijanet Muric denies him. The ball goes out of play. Brighton are awarded a corner kick.
35' Liam Delap (Ipswich) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
35' 1:1 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
33' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) comes close to scoring with a glancing header towards the left side of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies him by making a save.
31' Liam Delap (Ipswich) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
30' Leif Davis (Ipswich) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Samuel Barrott blows his whistle for a foul.
28' It’s hot out there so the ref signals there will be a cooling break for the players to take on some fluids.
27' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) forces a pass into the box, but Arijanet Muric is alert and does a great job to rob him of the ball.

27' Carlos Baleba (Brighton) attempted to send a defence-splitting pass into space where Yankuba Minteh was lurking. It could have put him one-on-one with the goalkeeper, but one of the defending players somehow manages to avert the threat.
25' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) tries to find Danny Welbeck, but he puts too much power on the pass.
24' Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
22' Carlos Baleba (Brighton) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
20' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle.
20' Brighton fail to score from a corner as Arijanet Muric (Ipswich) leaps to collect the ball.
19' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Samuel Barrott has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
18' Carlos Baleba (Brighton) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
15' The game is interrupted now, Omari Hutchinson (Ipswich) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
13' Georginio Rutter (Brighton) is adjudged offside.
12' Kalvin Phillips (Ipswich) was too forceful with his tackle and Samuel Barrott interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
9' Brighton can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
9' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball goes out for a corner. Brighton can continue in their attacking effort.
7' Samy Morsy (Ipswich) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.

7' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball.
5' Rough tackle by Georginio Rutter (Brighton). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
4' Carlos Baleba (Brighton) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the bottom left corner, but Arijanet Muric is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
1' The first half has just begun.
Ipswich will kick the game off.
Today's referee will be Samuel Barrott.
